# Playback V3 Click Templates

These are the approved source references for the V3 click-template registry. Runtime click events are generated only from `src/domain/click-templates.ts`; the app uses its regular and accent click sounds at those registered positions.

The duplicate root-level `4-4_Quarter.wav` from the delivery folder is intentionally excluded. `4-4-quarter.wav` is the approved 4/4 quarter reference.
